fields.description: Stored integrity word: low u16 of the custom table-driven CRC (FUN_08001fc0) computed over save[2:size). Verified on load with up to 3 retries.
fields.evidence: FUN_08054134 computes FUN_08001fc0(size-2, buf+2) and stores the low u16 at save+0x00; FUN_080541a0 recomputes FUN_08001fc0(size-2, buf+2) and compares it against save+0x00 (up to 3 read retries). Custom CRC-16 (seed DAT_08001ff8, table DAT_08001ffc, final bitwise NOT) is not in the Schema v2 algorithm list, so it is stored as a plain field. Baseline logical u16 @0x00 = 0xC283.
fields.name: save_checksum

fields.description: Save-valid marker: must be 0x01 for the load path to accept the save.
fields.evidence: FUN_080541a0 requires byte at save+0x02 == 0x01, else the save is rejected (*DAT_08054294 = 0xFFFFFFFF path); FUN_080542d0 sets save+0x02 = 1 when initializing the save buffer. Baseline = 1.
fields.name: save_valid_flag

fields.description: Fixed NUL-terminated ROM magic copied into the save on init and compared with strcmp on load.
fields.evidence: FUN_080542d0 runs FUN_08000328 strcpy(save+0x03, DAT_08054300); FUN_080541a0 runs FUN_08000310 strcmp(save+0x03, DAT_0805426c). Baseline logical save[0x03:0x0B] is ASCII 'Ss_SaveE' followed by a NUL at 0x0B.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Game configuration block copied from working RAM / ROM defaults (small-int option enumerations in the first 16 bytes, zero tail).
fields.evidence: FUN_080542d0 copies 0x18 bytes DAT_08054308 -> save+0x10; FUN_0805430c copies 0x18 bytes DAT_08054334 -> save+0x10. Baseline logical save[0x10:0x20] = 04 03 01 00 00 0F 01 00 00 01 02 00 00 02 01 00, save[0x20:0x28] all zero.
fields.name: config_options_block

fields.description: Per-stage progress record area copied from working RAM / ROM defaults; five nonzero u16 0x3B3B slots spaced 0x14 apart, remainder zero.
fields.evidence: FUN_080542d0 copies 0xC4 bytes *DAT_08054304 -> save+0x40; FUN_0805430c copies 0xC4 bytes *DAT_08054330 -> save+0x40. Baseline logical bytes show nonzero u16 0x3B3B at save+0x51+k*0x14 for k=0..4, zeros elsewhere in save[0x40:0x104].
fields.name: stage_progress_records

fields.description: Top score (10000) of ranking table A: first LE u32 of the 8-entry table at save+0x108.
fields.evidence: Save-I/O FUN_08054134 (write via FUN_080575f0, 57 x 8-byte EEPROM blocks) and FUN_080541a0 (read via FUN_0805740c) transfer the whole 0x1C8-byte buffer including save[0x108:0x1C8]. Baseline shows two 8-entry tables of LE u32 scores descending 10000..3000 (step 1000) with 3-byte initials and a constant 0x0C suffix byte; table A head at save+0x108 = 10000 (0x2710).
fields.name: ranking_score_best_a

fields.description: Ranking table A entries 2..8 (7 x 12 bytes: LE u32 score, LE u32 sub-value, 3 initials bytes, 0x0C suffix).
fields.evidence: Same save-I/O coverage as ranking_score_best_a (FUN_08054134 / FUN_080541a0, EEPROM blocks 33..40). Baseline save[0x10C:0x168] holds scores 9000..3000 with per-entry sub-values 45..15 and initials bytes.
fields.name: ranking_table_a_rest

fields.description: Top score (10000) of ranking table B (second mode): first LE u32 of the 8-entry table at save+0x168.
fields.evidence: Same save-I/O coverage as ranking_score_best_a (FUN_08054134 / FUN_080541a0, EEPROM blocks 41..48). Baseline LE u32 at save+0x168 = 10000 (0x2710), head of the second 8-entry score table with distinct initials from table A.
fields.name: ranking_score_best_b

fields.description: Ranking table B entries 2..8 (7 x 12 bytes: LE u32 score, LE u32 sub-value, 3 initials bytes, 0x0C suffix).
fields.evidence: Same save-I/O coverage as ranking_score_best_b (FUN_08054134 / FUN_080541a0, EEPROM blocks 41..56). Baseline save[0x16C:0x1C8] holds scores 9000..3000 with per-entry sub-values 45..15 and initials bytes distinct from table A.
fields.name: ranking_table_b_rest

magic_signatures.description: ASCII 'Ss_SaveE' header written by strcpy on init, checked by strcmp on load
